items.samenvatting_bron: None. Zaak:

document.tekst_begin: OPTIES VOOR INTENSIVERINGEN EN BESPARINGEN ARTIKEL 4 1. Inleiding Hieronder wordt een vooruitblik gegeven wat de verwachte ontwikkelingen zijn van aantallen en kosten van de Wajong bij ongewijzigd beleid. Tevens wordt gekeken naar mogelijkheden om de doeltreffendheid en/of doelmatigheid van de Wajong te versterken, waarbij beleidsopties worden verkend om enerzijds op de uitgaven van de Wajong te besparen en anderzijds om op de uitgaven te intensiveren. De beleidsopties kunnen momenteel nog niet inhoudelijk worden getoetst aan het VN-verdrag inzake de rechten van personen met een handicap, omdat de concrete beleidskaders nog onvoldoende zijn uitgekristalliseerd. Om een zorgvuldige toetsing mogelijk te maken, dienen deze kaders eerst nader te worden uitgewerkt. Als die kaders wel bekend zijn en er zijn gevolgen voor de positie van mensen met een beperking, moet, gelet op het VN-verdrag Handicap, beargumenteerd worden of wordt voldaan aan een aantal cumulatieve criteria. Allereerst is een redelijke rechtvaardiging nodig, waarbij noodzaak en proportionaliteit van de voorgestelde maatregel wordt vastgesteld. document.tekst_begin: Rapportage Hernieuwbare Energie voor Vervoer 2025 Naleving verplichtingen wet- en regelgeving Energie voor Vervoer Rapportage Energie voor Vervoer in Nederland 2025 2 Samenvatting en conclusies Vervoer en het gebruik van (fossiele) brandstoffen daarvoor veroorzaken een forse uitstoot van broeikas- gassen. De inzet van hernieuwbare energie in vervoer levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het verminderen van de CO2-uitstoot van transportbrandstoffen. De CO2-uitstoot van hernieuwbare energie is lager dan die van fossiele brandstoffen. In 2025 is de hoeveelheid hernieuwbare energie in vervoer in Nederland wederom gestegen. De jaar- verplichting van 29,4% hernieuwbare energie in vervoer is gerealiseerd. De CO2-uitstoot in de keten van brandstoffen is bovendien verder gedaald. Daarmee is de reductieverplichting ook gehaald. Deze trends zijn het gevolg van effectief gebleken regelgeving: de gestaag groeiende hoogte van de jaarverplichting. Deze is gerealiseerd door de inzet van brandstofleveranciers, daarbij ondersteund door de Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit (NEa). document.tekst_begin: Aan de Minister van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur TER BESLISSING Vraag lid Markuszower over Commissie Werkprogramma Pagina 1 van 1 Directoraat-generaal Agro Directie Europees, Internationaal en Agro economisch beleid Auteur Datum aangemaakt 04-11-2026 Kenmerk DGA-EIA / 108916573 Kopie aan Bijlage(n) 1 Ontvangen BPZ Parafenroute Aanleiding Het lid Markuszower heeft om een reactie gevraagd over de berichtgeving in de media van dinsdag 3 november jl. dat de Europese Commissie (hierna: Commissie) de Europese stikstofregels zou willen versoepelen. Geadviseerd besluit U kunt de brief ondertekenen. Kernpunten • In de beantwoording geeft u aan dat de Commissie vandaag haar werkprogramma voor 2027 heeft gepubliceerd en dat de versoepeling van stikstofregels niet in de gepresenteerde stukken staat. U geeft verder aan dat het kabinet het werkprogramma op gebruikelijke wijze zal appreciëren daarover de Kamer vóór het Kerstreces zal informeren. • Tot slot merkt u op dat er onverminderde urgentie is om de aanpak Landbouw, Natuur en Stikstof verder uit te werken.

items.titel: Assessing the energetic costs of nest building in birds
items.samenvatting_bron: Nest building plays an important role in the life of birds and it is assumed to be costly for builders. Although data from estimates of the costs of flights or the outcomes of reproduction are mixed, that nest building is costly remains prevalent. To my knowledge, there have been no direct tests of the costs of nest building on building birds. In the first experiment I pilot-tested a method for tracking mass loss in laboratory-housed zebra finches Taeniopygia guttata and found that at end of nest building the weight of males had decreased. The birds did not lose weight over a similar period when they were not building. In the two experiments that followed I attempted to determine possible causes of the costs. In the first experiment half of the birds built their nest with material 3x heavier than the material provided to the other birds. In the second experiment, I attempted to manipulate the costs of flights during nest building by providing the nest box at ground level or hung on the cage wall. items.titel: How to name dark fungal taxa outside the Code: The International Standard to Catalogue Dark Fungal Taxa (ISCDFT)
items.samenvatting_bron: There is an exponential increase in the number of fungal OTUs being documented by environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding. Many of these, the so-called dark fungal taxa (DFT), are known only from eDNA data, with no associated physical specimen or derived culture. Of the millions of fungal species predicted to exist, only ~205,000 are currently described, making it likely that many of these unknown or undescribed fungi are represented only by eDNA data. For more than a decade mycologists have struggled with whether the International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (the Code ) should allow for formal description of fungal taxa from eDNA data alone, i.e. with a DNA sequence serving as a type. It is, however, unlikely that an amendment to the Code with this provision will pass in the near future. It is therefore imperative to establish an informal yet structured naming system to allow unified communication about DFT. The system proposed herein applies most of the principles of the Code to generate designations that, while nomenclatorially invalid, can nonetheless be integrated into fungal classifications and diversity assessments. We used the 2025 Westerdijk Spring Symposium "DNA Sequences as Type" to bring mycologists together to work out community consensus-driven conventions and standards for what we call the International Standard to Catalogue Dark Fungal Taxa (ISCDFT). items.titel: From DNA Detection to Reliable Biodiversity Assessment: Methodological Priorities for Environmental DNA Metabarcoding in the African Great Lakes Region
items.samenvatting_bron: Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding can broaden freshwater biodiversity assessment by detecting genetic material released by organisms into water. Its value for conservation, however, depends on how confidently sequence detections can be linked to taxa and interpreted in space and time. This narrative mini review examines methodological priorities for tropical African freshwater monitoring, using the Lake Albert study in the Albertine Rift as a geographically direct example and the Rufiji River catchment in Tanzania as a comparative East African river-system case. A targeted, non-systematic literature search was used to identify these focal studies and methodological literature on reference libraries, marker resolution, eDNA transport and persistence, replication, contamination control, and taxonomic assignment. The review distinguishes two related but different identification problems: missing or unreliable reference sequences and markers that cannot separate closely related species even when reference sequences are available. It also explains why DNA transported downstream or persisting after release can indicate genetic material without proving that a living population occupies the precise sampling point. Practical recommendations are presented for interpreting negative controls, replicate agreement, and assignment confidence without imposing universal thresholds that are not supported across assays and ecosystems. Airborne eDNA has been sampled using various stationary devices, but if we can access it using mobile collection methods, we can rapidly assess biodiversity at large spatial scales. items.titel: Applications of Environmental DNA Technology for Investigating Ecological Succession in Artificial Aquatic Habitats
items.samenvatting_bron: Artificial aquatic habitats including reservoirs, reclamation waters and constructed wetlands undergo dynamic ecological development, marked by continuous community turnover, trophic reorganisation and shifts in ecosystem function. Meanwhile, traditional biodiversity monitoring methods rely on morphological taxonomic surveys and microscopic identification. They are highly time-consuming, labor-intensive, and strongly dependent on taxonomic expertise. These approaches struggle to capture continuous community dynamics across multiple trophic groups and underestimate cryptic and small-sized benthic organisms. Environmental DNA detects DNA fragments released by organisms into the environment, supporting high-throughput and non-invasive surveys of biological communities. This review synthesizes representative published studies concerning eDNA applications in artificial aquatic habitats. We summarise the strengths of eDNA for biodiversity monitoring, and identify practical obstacles specific to engineered aquatic systems, including sampling bias and data correction. We further propose targeted future research prospects in artificial habitat ecological evaluation and restoration management. This review demonstrates that eDNA is a powerful tool for evaluating constructed aquatic ecosystems and highlights future opportunities via multi-technology integration to promote sustainable ecological infrastructure design.

items.titel: Optimizing biodiversity benefits of NBS in nature-based urban climate adaptation
items.samenvatting_bron: Nature-based Solutions (NBS) have the potential to provide solutions to a range of societal challenges, such as climate adaptation, and simultaneously contribute toward biodiversity goals. NBS are increasingly implemented in urban sustainability practice, especially in residential districts and business sites. This provides a great chance to simultaneously enhance local urban nature at the place where people live and work. However, as urban professionals have a predominant focus on climate adaptation functionality, the NBS design often misses opportunities to benefit biodiversity to its full potential. To change this, we present a three-step approach: (i) we developed a typology of biodiversity benefits that urban NBS may possess, (ii) for 14 widely used urban NBS, prioritized for climate adaptation, we estimate their performance on these biodiversity benefits based upon literature and expert judgment, (iii) we call for follow-up actions by policymakers, practitioners and scientists to not miss the opportunities that the urban “climate adaptation” NBS have to offer in making cities more biodiverse and to enhance connections between people and nature.

items.samenvatting_bron: ABSTRACT The figure presents presents the evolution urban water cycle management from the traditional to the holistic approach, in which the spaces in the city become also sources of water and sinks for wastewater and stormwater. This evolution enhances the circularity of urban water cycle, reducing the environmental pressure both for water consumption and wastewater discharge, while reducing urban flood risk. At an urban level, water supply and wastewater drainage are usually managed considering a separation of the public (off the buildings) and private system (on the buildings) roles. However, for a more sustainable urban water cycle management capable of facing future water-related challenges, this separation of roles is not effective and a holistic approach is required. The present contribution reviews the evolution of the urban water cycle management approaches and discusses the potential of implementing solutions in private systems to increase water efficiency, satisfy water demand needs and contribute to wastewater and stormwater discharge reduction at an urban level. Searches of Scopus and the Web of Science Core Collection, supplemented by Google Scholar, yielded 272 publications classified by publication period, research method and thematic domain. The evidence is uneven: 43.4% of records address hydrological function, and 17.3% bioeconomic valuation; 49.3% are reviews or conceptual contributions, and only 8.8% apply a formal economic valuation technique. document.tekst_begin: Nationale biogrondstoffenstrategie 2026 Boodschap Biogrondstoffen zijn cruciaal om invulling te geven aan menselijke behoeften. Vanzelfsprekend als bron van voedsel, maar ook voor gebruik in materialen en als energiebron. In de toekomst neemt het belang van biogrondstoffen verder toe, omdat ze een belangrijke rol vervullen als duurzame vervanger van fossiele grondstoffen in een weerbare, klimaatneutrale en circulaire economie. Dit vraagt om een andere manier van omgaan met biogrondstoffen: een ander gebruik en een verandering in aanbod en verwerking van biogrondstoffen. Het betekent gedragsverandering, een ander consumptiepatroon, ander landgebruik en andere industrie. Er ontstaan nieuwe routes, nieuwe verdienmodellen en nieuwe toepassingen voor het gebruik van biogrondstoffen. We werken toe naar een duurzaam systeem, gericht op brede welvaart en met respect voor ecologische grenzen. Zo ontstaat een systeem dat burgers voorziet van een breed scala aan waardevolle producten en nieuwe perspectieven biedt aan ondernemers in de landbouw, de industrie, de bouw en andere sectoren. document.tekst_begin: Non-Paper by Estonia, Finland, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden and Czechia on the Cyber Security Act 2 Guiding principles to make the ICT supply chain mechanism work We welcome the Commission’s proposal to mitigate cybersecurity risks at EU level. The Cybersecurity Act 2, more speciﬁcally the introduction of a new European framework for securing ICT supply chains, directly aƯects cybersecurity, strategic dependencies and the functioning of the internal market. Having a risk-based approach underpinned by thorough risk analyses is a strong foundation to enhance the EU’s resilience. We would therefore like to underline our support for the objectives of this framework, as it is in our view the most pragmatic and coherent way to face the threats and manage those risks that aƯect the Union. We also support moving first with a phase out on mobile networks, building on the experience with the 5G Cyber Security Toolbox. However, further risk assessments are needed when it comes to the fixed and satellite networks. Where those developments confront us with attestable resilience and autonomy externalities, we should work together to enable our industries to counter those externalities by developing necessary capabilities they do not (sufficiently) provide. That means creating market activity insufficiently present or altogether absent, inasmuch warranted to protect ourselves from undue foreign influence infringing on the EU’s autonomy. Het CBS-trendmodel levert betrouwbare trendinschattingen gebaseerd op de steekproefgegevens van OVG-MON-OViN-ODiN (Boonstra & Van den Brakel, 2026). Dit model houdt op een robuuste manier rekening met discontinuïteiten veroorzaakt door wijzigingen in het enquêteproces en steekproefruis. Het beschrijft de ontwikkeling van het gehele Nederlandse energiesysteem op het pad van de energietransitie en biedt daarbij vele nuttige inzichten. Dat onderstaande reflectie een aantal kritische noten bevat, doet niet af aan de waardering voor het uitgevoerde werk en moet vooral gezien worden als een oproep het volgende NPE, in 2029, nog beter te maken. Met het geactualiseerde Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem (hierna: NPE 2026) wil het kabinet richting en duidelijkheid geven wat betreft de uitvoering van de energietransitie en de daartoe noodzakelijke beleidsmaatregelen. document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op 10 september 2026 heeft de commissie voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening van de Tweede Kamer verzocht te reageren op een brief van Kavel 10 B.V. Kavel 10 is een Nederlands geo-bedrijf. In deze brief uit Kavel 10 zorgen over het lopende traject van de Basisvoorziening Beeldmateriaal (BVBM), met name over de onzorgvuldige voorbereiding, dreigende marktverstoring en het ontbreken van een onafhankelijke toets. Kavel 10 geeft aan direct geraakt te worden door de ontwikkelingen van BVBM. De voorgenomen uitwerking dreigt volgens Kavel 10 een functionerende Nederlandse marktsector te verdringen. Het verzoek is het traject te pauzeren tot een onafhankelijke toets van nut, noodzaak, juridische grondslag en marktimpact heeft plaatsgevonden, en tot de meest geraakte marktpartijen formeel zijn gehoord. De BVBM is primair gericht op het structureel borgen van reeds bestaande luchtfoto’s en hoogtebestanden (AHN) van Nederland. Een eventuele verbreding waar de brief zich op richt zit nog in de verkennende fase, er is nog geen concreet voorstel uitgewerkt. Op 23 oktober jl. is gesproken met Kavel 10. Hierbij waren aanwezig. De analyse concludeerde dat versnelling noodzakelijk is om de continuïteit van de treinbeveiliging te waarborgen, investeringen in verouderde systemen zoveel mogelijk te vermijden en tijdig te voldoen aan de Europese verplichtingen voor de realisatie van één Europese spoorwegruimte. In april was ik in Franeker getuige van de installatie van de eerste ERTMS-onderdelen in het spoor. Op de Noordelijke Lijnen komt de sterke onderlinge afhankelijkheid tussen ombouw van infrastructuur, materieel en ontwikkeling van IT-systemen steeds duidelijker naar voren. Het risicoprofiel van de realisatie van de eerste baanvakken blijft hoog. Vooral het opleveren van het generieke systeem Central Safety System (CSS) heeft de nadrukkelijke aandacht. De eerste versie van dit systeem is opgeleverd door de leverancier en moet de komende periode integraal getest en uiteindelijk vrijgegeven worden. items.titel: Research on Emission Inventory and Emission Reduction Benefits Assessment of Non-Road Construction Machinery in Tangshan Port
items.samenvatting_bron: This study investigated the emission inventory and reduction strategies of non-road construction machinery in Tangshan Port. A Portable Emission Measurement System (PEMS) was used to collect operating condition data and measure pollutant emissions from 16 pieces of machinery under real-world operating conditions. Based on the field measurements, emission factors for typical construction machinery in Tangshan Port were established. The emission reduction effects and cost-effectiveness of different scenarios of phase-out and Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) emission control ratios for China III emission standard non-road construction machinery at Tangshan Port were analyzed. The results showed that the estimated annual operating hours of excavators, loaders, forklifts, and bulldozers in the port were 3.51, 4.87, 3.44, and 2.34 times the corresponding values recommended in the “Technical Guidelines for the Compilation of Emission Inventories of Non-road Mobile Pollution Sources (Trial)”, respectively, indicating relatively high utilization intensity. Emissions of PM, NOx, HC, and CO from port construction machinery were mainly attributable to excavators and loaders, with combined contribution rates of 66.65%, 68.58%, 60.89%, and 59.85%, respectively. items.titel: Clubmosses (Lycopodiaceae, Lycopodiales) in the Herbarium Collection of the Croatian Natural History Museum (CNHM): implications for nature conservation
items.samenvatting_bron: During the curation of the Herbarium Collection of the Croatian Natural History Museum – CNHM, special attention was given to clubmosses (Lycopodiaceae), which are of conservation concern – they are all listed in Annex V of the EU Habitats Directive and in Croatia their commercial collection is regulated, except for two species that are strictly protected. Results show that the collection contains 115 herbarium sheets of clubmosses with 221 herbarium specimens, which include 99 inventory numbers. Lycopodium clavatum is the most numerous in terms of inventory numbers and herbarium sheets and Huperzia selago in terms of herbarium specimens. Clubmosses were collected over a period of 127 years, with the greatest intensity of their collection in the first decades of the 20 th century and in the period of the 1960s and 1970s. The largest number of clubmosses was, expectedly, collected in Croatia. Clubmosses were collected by 16 collectors and identified by nine identifiers. Material of clubmosses stored in the CNHM Herbarium Collection is predominantly old and does not cover their entire known distribution area in Croatia. However, the curated data can be used for preparing the report on the conservation status of species according to the Habitats Directive, as well as for extinction risk assessment. They are an important source of evidence for the presence of plant species in a given area at a specific point in time.

items.titel: Pollinator-promoting wildflower fields attract farmland birds and rodents, depending on spatial configuration and landscape context
items.samenvatting_bron: To mitigate the decline of pollinators in farmlands, a widely used approach is to establish wildflower fields. Their effects beyond pollinators, however, require further investigation in Central-Eastern Europe, even regarding popular taxa such as birds, and potential pest species such as rodents. We established wildflower plantings in two spatial configurations (one field or three strips with the same area per plot) in both homogeneous and heterogeneous agricultural landscapes in Central Hungary. We found that fields increase bird species number, individual number and Shannon-diversity in homogeneous agricultural landscapes, but not in heterogeneous landscapes, which in general are more diverse regardless of wildflower plantings. Also, wildflower fields promote rodents compared to arable fields. Thus, wildflower fields may have a wide range of biodiversity benefits beyond pollinators depending on field area and landscape context. These results provide evidence from Central-Eastern Europe to support the implementation of the European Union's Nature Restoration Regulation.

items.titel: Successfully Implementing ESG Practices at India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL): A Case Analysis
items.samenvatting_bron: Case analysis provides insights into the successful integration of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles at India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a premier government-owned financial institution (FI) dedicated to supporting the development of sustainable infrastructure in India. IIFCL has emerged as a leader in sustainable finance by embedding ESG considerations into its investment decision-making, risk assessment, and governance frameworks. The case highlights key strategic initiatives, including the adoption of ESG risk screening tools, alignment with international sustainability standards, and the promotion of green infrastructure projects. Through stakeholder engagement, internal capacity-building, and policy innovation, IIFCL has demonstrated how innovative financial solutions can effectively balance developmental mandates with long-term environmental and social sustainability. The study provides insights into the challenges, enablers, and measurable outcomes of IIFCL’s ESG journey, acting as a paradigm for other institutions aiming to incorporate ESG frameworks into infrastructure financing.

items.titel: From Riverbank to Region: Green–Blue Infrastructure, Cultural Heritage and Ecotourism Spatial Integration in Bihor County, Romania
items.samenvatting_bron: Climate change, urban heat islands and climate hazard risks are putting pressure on tourism in the historic quarters. This study assesses the spatial preconditions for a resilient ecotourism infrastructure in Bihor County, Romania. By examining ecological and cultural resources and low-impact accessibility across three scales (the county, the metropolitan area and the city of Oradea, particularly its historic quarter), together with land surface temperature variations, the study identifies the weakest points in the region’s ecotourism potential. A multi-scale GIS framework was applied, overlaying ecosystem services, blue–green infrastructure (BGI) components, cultural heritage assets and land surface temperature (LST) data. The results indicate that Bihor County holds a fragmented but genuine foundation for an ecotourism network, with the Crișul Repede River as the main connector. GBI can support low-impact ecotourism routes within Oradea, but only partially in the current configuration, as the historic quarter presents insufficient green connectivity. Moreover, the most important ecological areas are vehicle dependent. The multi-scale assessment further reveals a complex interdependency between tourism potential, urban planning policy, mobility infrastructure and climate exposure.

items.titel: Phenology-Aware Urban Vegetation Mapping with Multi-Temporal PlanetScope Imagery and Machine Learning
items.samenvatting_bron: Urban vegetation plays a crucial role in regulating microclimates, mitigating the urban heat island effect, improving air quality, and contributing to climate resilience—functions increasingly vital amid accelerating climate change. Despite this importance, mapping vegetation in urban environments remains challenging, particularly at the species level, due to structural complexity, mixed land use, and spectral similarity among vegetation types. In this study, we developed a hierarchical multi-temporal framework using high-resolution (3 m) PlanetScope imagery with time-series analysis to classify urban vegetation and dominant tree species by capturing their phenological trajectories. PlanetScope imagery from 2021 to 2023 was first averaged into monthly composites. These monthly composites were subsequently organized into annual multi-temporal feature stacks (Y.C.), seasonal multi-temporal feature stacks (S.C.), individual seasonal datasets, and monthly datasets. Spectral bands were combined with five vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, GNDVI, MSAVI, and NIRv) to represent seasonal variations in vegetation characteristics. A Random Forest classifier was applied at the pixel level. The Y.C. yielded the highest performance for broad vegetation classification (Overall Accuracy = 94.33%, Kappa = 0.92), followed by S.C., while individual seasons and months generally produced lower accuracies. items.samenvatting_bron: Urban trees are important components of green infrastructure, contributing to biodiversity conservation, climate regulation, and carbon storage. This study evaluated species composition, diversity, structural characteristics, biomass, carbon storage, and the economic value of stored carbon in 15 Temmuz National Garden, Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye. Branch, leaf, and bark samples were collected, and biomass and carbon storage were estimated using the KARBİYOSİS (Carbon Storage and Biomass Calculation System) software. A total of 525 trees representing 22 taxa, 19 genera, and 13 families were recorded. items.titel: Reconsidering The 15 - Minute City in Post - Socialist Urban Contexts : The Case of Rzeszow, Poland

Nevertheless, the practical implementation of this concept in dynamically developing medium - sized cities in Central and Eastern Europe remains insufficiently explored. In many post - socialist urban environments, transformation processes continue to prioritize transport efficiency, investment pressures, and spatial expansion, frequently marginalizing issues related to accessibility, social inclusiveness, environmental quality, and the everyday usability of public spaces. This paper critically examines the applicability of the 15 - minute city concept using Rzeszow — one of the fastest - growing regional cities in south - eastern Poland — as a case study. items.samenvatting_bron: Human-Elephant Conflict (HEC) has emerged as a critical conservation, governance and socio-environmental challenge in India; particularly in Odisha, where high elephant populations coexist with expanding human activities. Increasing human-elephant interactions have resulted in rising human fatalities, elephant deaths, crop loss, habitat fragmentation, and livelihood insecurity. This study examines the ecological, socio-economic, legal, and governance dimensions of HEC in Odisha with particular emphasis on compensation mechanisms, coexistence strategies, and conservation governance. The policy and practice review research paper adopts a qualitative and doctrinal research methodology based primarily on secondary data, including government reports, policy documents, wildlife literature, census records, and conservation studies. Through interdisciplinary analysis, the paper identifies habitat fragmentation, land-use change, mining activities, infrastructure expansion, climate variability, and socio-economic vulnerabilities as major drivers intensifying HEC in the state. items.titel: Monitoring deep-sea fish biodiversity via a direct deep-water intake from 612 m: Insights into taxonomic composition and temporal dynamics revealed by eDNA metabarcoding
items.samenvatting_bron: We investigated the taxonomic composition and temporal dynamics of deep-sea fish assemblages off subtropical Kume Island, Japan, using environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding of water samples from a fixed deep-water intake system. Over 26 months (December 2020–February 2023), 60 high-volume samples (20 L each) were collected from an intake mouth located near the seafloor of the continental slope at 612 m depth during six sampling events. MiFish metabarcoding identified 283 deep-sea fish taxa. Comparison with a regional checklist showed high overlap at family and genus levels but limited species-level overlap. The eDNA dataset included bathydemersal taxa alongside pelagic and mesopelagic groups (e.g., Myctophidae, Stomiidae), which were proportionally more prominent than in the regional checklist. Despite relatively stable environmental conditions at 612 m, NMDS and PERMANOVA revealed significant differences in community composition among sampling events. The February 2023 assemblage showed the greatest separation from the other events. The similarity between December 2020 and December 2021 suggests that seasonal processes may contribute to the observed temporal variation, but the present sampling design does not establish a recurring annual cycle. These findings highlight the potential of intake-based eDNA monitoring as a repeatable framework for detecting broad-scale ecological shifts in the deep ocean.

items.titel: High-density environmental DNA metabarcoding reveals fine-scale three-dimensional structure of a fish community in a semi-closed bay
items.samenvatting_bron: Coastal fish assemblages are influenced by environmental heterogeneity across horizontal and vertical dimensions, yet their fine-scale three-dimensional structure remains poorly understood. We investigated spatial variation in fish assemblages using environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding at 100 stations across three depth layers (300 samples) in Maizuru Bay, a semi-enclosed coastal bay in Japan. Concurrent hydrographic measurements were used to examine associations between fish assemblage composition and environmental conditions. We detected 216 fish species, with mean species richness decreasing from 28.4 at the surface to 16.4 at the bottom. Thirty-three species were detected exclusively below the surface. Fish assemblage composition differed significantly among depth layers and exhibited pronounced horizontal turnover along the bay axis. Although depth, geographic position, and measured environmental variables were associated with assemblage composition, they collectively explained only 13.0% of the variation. The independent contribution of spatial position (2.9%) exceeded those of depth (0.8%) and measured environmental variables (0.9%). These findings demonstrate substantial three-dimensional heterogeneity in coastal fish assemblages that cannot be fully explained by conventional hydrographic measurements. Our study highlights the importance of integrating horizontal and vertical sampling to characterize coastal fish biodiversity and improve marine ecosystem monitoring.

items.titel: Integrating environmental DNA and species distribution modelling reveals the spatiotemporal distribution and habitat dynamics of the Chinese sturgeon (Acipenser sinensis)
items.samenvatting_bron: The Chinese sturgeon ( Acipenser sinensis ), a flagship species of the Yangtze River basin, is among the world's most endangered anadromous fishes. Traditional monitoring approaches largely rely on field observations, which are labor-intensive and inefficient. In the present study, we conducted general environmental DNA (eDNA) surveys at 44 sites and depth-stratified sampling at 4 representative regions across the currently recognized riverine range of Acipenser sinensis in the Yangtze River. eDNA-derived occurrence records were used as presence data in MaxEnt species distribution modelling. The model was used to identify current suitable habitats and project future changes in potential habitat across the basin. The results showed that the Chinese sturgeon eDNA was widely detected throughout this study area, and redundancy analysis suggested that COD Mn is the environmental variable most strongly associated with the eDNA occurrence. The final MaxEnt model achieved a mean test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.809, with current habitat suitability concentrated in the middle and lower Yangtze River network. items.titel: A Museum‐Curated, Voucher‐Backed 12S Barcode Reference Library for Fishes of the Ecuadorian Amazon
items.samenvatting_bron: ABSTRACT Environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding is an emerging method that promises to expedite and improve biodiversity surveys by identifying species from the genetic material they shed into the environment. eDNA methods offer many advantages over conventional specimen‐based surveys, but their effectiveness hinges on reference libraries, which for highly biodiverse regions such as the Ecuadorian Amazon are too often incomplete, inconsistently curated and disconnected from morphological voucher specimens needed to reliably identify and revise taxa. To address this gap, we collected approximately 5000 fish specimens and 1500 tissues of an estimated 311 morphologically defined species from Ecuador's Aguarico, Napo and Pastaza river basins, and built a new, rigorously curated, museum voucher–backed 12S reference library spanning 748 barcodes from over 303 species across 12 orders, 46 families and 171 genera. When tested against unknown haplotypes from concurrently collected eDNA samples, the library nearly doubled the proportion identified to species (40.0%, vs. 21.3% using GenBank). It also enabled the empirical estimation of new species‐level barcode thresholds: 0.4% for the full‐length barcode, 0.9% for a general vertebrate mini‐barcode, and 0.6% for a fish‐specific mini‐barcode. items.titel: Aligning and simplifying chemical, industrial emission and water quality regulations: Towards a coherent EU framework for persistent, mobile and toxic (PMT) and very persistent, very mobile (vPvM) substances
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Background : Persistent, mobile and toxic (PMT) and very persistent and very mobile (vPvM) substances threaten water resources when released in large volumes because they persist in the environment, spread readily through aquatic systems, and are difficult to remove once contamination has occurred. The introduction of the PMT and vPvM hazard classes under the Classification, Labelling and Packaging (CLP) Regulation represents an important step toward identifying PMT/vPvM substances, but effective environmental protection requires consistent regulatory advancements and alignments across related EU chemicals legislation to include these hazard classes. This paper examines how the Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Regulation, the Industrial Emissions Directive (IED), and the Water Framework Directive (WFD) currently regulate PMT/vPvM substances and identifies opportunities to strengthen the coherence of these legislative frameworks to protect water resources. Results : The analysis shows that the current regulatory framework remains fragmented. Under REACH, PMT/vPvM substances can only be identified systematically through the resource-intensive equivalent level of concern clause, delaying risk management measures. Under the IED, emissions control largely depends on regulatory pathways established under REACH and the WFD. items.titel: Assessing Urban Development Capacity Under Water Constraints: A Planning - Oriented Index for Spatial Policy
items.samenvatting_bron: Rapid urbanization and increasing pressure on water resources challenge the sustainability of conventional spatial planning practices. Traditional approaches, primarily based on functional zoning and post hoc infrastructure design, often neglect the dynamic relationship between urban development and water availability. This has led to overdevelopment in many regions — particularly coastal and tourism - intensive areas — where water demand exceeds supply capacity, resulting in resource stress and reduced system resilience. This study proposes a novel planning - oriented framework — the Urban Water Adequacy for Development Index (UWADI) — which integrates water resource constraints into the early stages of spatial planning. Unlike conventional assessments based on observed consumption, UWADI relies exclusively on planned development parameters, enabling prior evaluation of whether proposed urban growth is compatible with available water resources. The index is defined on a scale from 0 to 1 and consists of four components: Adequacy Deficit (AD), representing the balance between planned demand and available supply; Seasonal Exposure (SE), capturing peak demand variability; Resource Vulnerability (RV), reflecting the robustness of water sources; and Phasing Mismatch (PM), addressing the temporal alignment between infrastructure provision and development. items.titel: Urban densification to support climate adaptation: balancing costs and agglomeration benefits in the Netherlands
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Where should we build new housing under growing climate hazards? This study develops a framework that balances the economic benefits of density against the geographically varying costs of climate adaptation. We apply it to the Netherlands, where demand for new housing is high, but much of the land lies in floodplains or subsidence-prone areas. Agglomeration benefits are proxied by land values, while adaptation costs are derived from engineering estimates of flood protection and soil subsidence. Combining these data allows us to map spatial trade-offs and identify where development remains welfare-enhancing. Our findings show that dense cities continue to generate strong net welfare gains, even in places with high costs, while low-density settlements generate a welfare loss for new housing. We identify density thresholds above which housing development becomes feasible. Many medium-sized Dutch cities already exceed these thresholds, making densification more beneficial than peripheral expansion. Climate adaptation thus strengthens—rather than weakens—the case for urban densification.

items.titel: Enhancing Coastal Resilience: A Case Study on Nature-based Solutions and Community Management in Indo-Bangladesh Borderland Coast
items.samenvatting_bron: This study investigates the potential of nature-based solutions (NbS) and community management practices in strengthening resilience along the Indo-Bangladesh borderland coast, focusing on how ecological restoration combined with participatory governance can mitigate climate risks while sustaining livelihoods. Conducted in the North and South 24 Parganas, a region highly vulnerable to cyclones, tidal surges, and salinity intrusion, the research employed a participatory and qualitative methodology that included fieldwork with 50 households across diverse occupational groups and 20 focus group discussions (FGDs). items.titel: Nature-Based Solutions, Smart City Technologies, and Sustainable Urban Mobility: Towards an Operational Model (A Case Study of Tehran)
items.samenvatting_bron: Rapid urbanisation has intensified critical environmental challenges, notably in developing world towns and cities. This article examines the relationship between three core concepts in this urban landscape: Nature-Based Solutions (NBS), Smart City Technologies (SCTs), and Sustainable Urban Mobility (SUM). Through a Systematic Literature Review, the article develops a provisional conceptual framework (PCF) for mapping these concepts, identifying synergistic domains and mobility dimensions. This framework is then applied in an analysis of the Tehran urban environment, using GIS data and a follow-up evaluation questionnaire with expert practitioners. The findings reveal spatial inequalities in the occurrence of these three concepts across the Tehran municipality, highlighting the limited integration of NBS with smart mobility initiatives and more specifically the distinction between spatial co-location and actual functional integration. Results from the Tehran case study are used to evolve the PCF into a tiered operational model comprising spatial and technology components and implementation mechanisms and constraints. items.titel: Toward bio-inclusive urban design: a relational approach to co-existence
items.samenvatting_bron: Ecological frameworks – such as Nature-based Solutions and Biophilic design – have advanced ecological thinking in urban planning and encouraged nature-connectedness, yet both focus on the utilitarian functions of nature. This externalisation and instrumentalisation of nature as a service provider sparingly acknowledges non-human agency in urban design. Through a targeted purposive scoping review, the paper maps conceptual gaps in these frameworks and explores more-than-human alternatives that support a bio-inclusive approach to urban design. Drawing on ecological empathy and animist awareness, and Freya Mathews’s concepts of conativity and least resistance, the paper argues that a relational understanding is required for an ontological shift to support multispecies co-existence. By conceptually linking ontological foundations with Freya Mathews’s concepts as operating principles, we propose five guiding principles that foreground ethical care, humans as actors, interdisciplinary interdependence, designing for entanglement and detachment, and including epistemological diversity. Together, these would help operationalise a bio-inclusive design framework that supports ecological reciprocity and symbiotic co-existence. The paper contributes to emerging discourse in post-anthropocentric urban planning, multispecies justice, and environmental ethics. It emphasises relationality through a conceptual foundation that can inform design education, policy, and practice.

items.titel: What shapes urban planning trade-offs of NBS in compact city agendas: a case study of the Catharijnesingel restoration in Utrecht, the Netherlands
items.samenvatting_bron: The current research examines the intersection of urban nature-based solutions (NBS) and the compact city model, interrogating how processes of the compact city influence the manifestation of NBS-related trade-offs across the urban planning cycle. We conceptualise and operationalise a synthesis between the types of urban NBS trade-offs, processes of compact urbanism and environmental justice dimensions. Using the restoration of the Catharijnesingel canal in Utrecht, the Netherlands, as a case study, we examine the existing trade-offs and how compact urbanism influences them as they arise, evolve, and manifest. This conceptual and analytical framework was applied to the case study using a qualitative approach through interviews, document analysis, and site observations. The research uncovered linkages between governance approaches, the city’s metabolic flows, and socio-spatial antagonisms with the captured urban NBS trade-offs. The findings highlight the importance of accounting for what drives urban NBS trade-offs in relation to the environment within which the NBS are implemented, to interrogate environmental injustices.

items.titel: Climate-Resilient Spatial Zoning for Temporary Cultural Infrastructures: A framework for Flood-Prone Contexts
items.samenvatting_bron: Event spaces and cultural areas are often built temporarily. These temporary structures are built without considering the possibility of defending against extreme weather events like floods. Under unforeseen situations like extreme weather, the accessibility and services will collapse. The impact on this will be particularly significant on the vulnerable population, mainly older adults and children. This study will develop a reproducible framework for creating these temporary cultural and event zones that withstand extreme weather events, using the open - source QGIS software. Buffer zones were delineated at distances of 15, 50, and 150 meters from the centre of the river line. The site is divided into three functional zones, based on accessibility, terrain conditions, and risk exposure within the buffer zone. Each zone is then strategically supported with multiple smaller systems spread across the site, nature - based solutions and certain other functions that can operate without disruption during extreme events. These facilities are designed to be close, accessible, and safe for all users, including older adults, people with physical disabilities, and children. The approach offers a low - cost, replicable strategy for climate resilience that can be integrated into temporary cultural and event spaces. This idea can be relevant to projects like Cirk Arena, especially for creating functional, flexible and safe event spaces that can run during extreme weather conditions.

items.samenvatting_bron: by Erik Joaquín Torres-Romero, Maximilian L. Allen, Vincent Nijman, Moreno Di Marco, Christopher J. O’Bryan, Vincenzo Penteriani Wildlife trade is a major driver of biodiversity loss, yet how trade interacts with species’ ecological traits and extinction risk remains underexplored. Carnivores warrant special attention because they are disproportionately exploited and vulnerable to extinction compared to other taxa. We analyzed 171,637 international trade records spanning 50 years (1975–2024) for 129 carnivore species listed under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES). We analyzed trade volumes across the globe and then used logistic regression to evaluate associations between ecological traits and extinction risk, as well as family-level differences in extinction risk. Trade volumes were dominated by exports from North America and Europe and imports concentrated in East Asia, highlighting persistent transcontinental trade. Among carnivore families, only Ursidae (bears) exhibited significantly greater odds of being threatened relative to the Canidae (canids) reference family. items.titel: Microclimatic regulation effects of landscape elements on university campus in a temperate monsoon climate zone: A case study during extreme summer heat
items.samenvatting_bron: by Lei Fan, Yixin Liang, Zixian Li, Yan Zhou Although temperate monsoon climate regions are traditionally known for their harsh winter climates, the combined effects of rapid urbanization and global climate change have significantly intensified summer urban heat island effects in these areas, making them a neglected yet increasingly severe challenge in high-latitude urban climate adaptation planning. This study takes a typical campus in Shenyang, a temperate monsoon climate region in Northeast China, as the experimental subject. It quantitatively dissects the non-linear statistical associations and regulatory mechanisms of biotic and abiotic landscape elements and their spatial configurations on microclimate parameters and human thermal comfort (Physiologically Equivalent Temperature, PET) by combining microclimate field observations with validated ENVI-met numerical simulations. Field measurement results show that the vertical structural characteristics of vegetation dominate cooling efficiency: evergreen trees and shrubs, with their dense radiation-blocking structures, exhibit optimal regulatory potential, with mean Physiological Equivalent Temperature (ΔPET) values reaching 10.6°C and 10.4°C, respectively, significantly outperforming deciduous trees (8.1°C). De WOZ-waarde gaat onder andere ervan uit dat de woning niet wordt verhuurd. De verhuurde staat van een woning kan gevolgen hebben voor de waardebepaling. Daarmee geen rekening houden zou tot ongewenste uitkomsten kunnen leiden in situaties waarin een woning met huurbescherming is verhuurd. Daarom geldt voor die situatie zowel voor box 3 als voor de schenk- en erfbelasting een afwijkende regeling: de leegwaarderatio-regeling. Voor de waardebepaling wordt dan uitgegaan van een bepaald percentage van de WOZ-waarde van de woning dat weer wordt bepaald aan de hand van de huuropbrengst. De Kamer heeft u gevraagd de VCK vóór het debat te informeren over een aantal zaken. Met bijgaande brief geeft u daar opvolging aan. Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd de brief te tekenen. document.tekst_begin: Financiering kwijtgescholden en lopende WIA-voorschotten Het voorstel voor de financiering van kwijtgescholden en lopende WIA-voorschotten is uitvoerbaar, mits het wetsvoorstel wordt gewijzigd voor het onderdeel waarbij werkgever per cliënt het voorschot wel of niet mag betalen. Dit gezien de extra complexiteit dat dit oplevert in registratie en afrekening na beoordeling. Deze aanpassing lijkt onhaalbaar en tijdrovend. Ook moet het wetsvoorstel worden gewijzigd voor het onderdeel waarbij werkgever de keuze heeft om het voorschot zelf te betalen. Het zelf betalen van het voorschot van werkgever vraagt om een complexe wijziging en ook om een complexe administratieve aanpassing in de systemen bij UWV. Overigens constateren wij dat dit voorstel voor de financiering van kwijtgescholden en lopende WIA-voorschotten de uitvoering van de WIA complexer maakt. Het voorstel creëert in onze administratie een nieuw soort WIA-uitkering ‘voorschot’ naast de huidige IVA- en WGA-uitkering. Meer complexiteit toevoegen aan de WIA is onwenselijk, de opgave is juist om de WIA sterk te vereenvoudigen. document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2026–2027 37 020 XVII Vaststelling van de begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2027 Nr. 30 MOTIE VAN DE LEDEN DOBBE EN KRÖGER Voorgesteld tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg van 5 november 2026 De Kamer, gehoord de beraadslaging, constaterende dat de mondiale antirechtenbeweging de inspanningen op gendergelijkheid van dit kabinet actief ondermijnt; constaterende dat deze beweging een wereldwijde financiering ontvangt van tenminste 1 miljard euro per jaar, maar er veel onduidelijkheid is over de herkomst van geldstromen; verzoekt de regering de financiers van de antirechtenbeweging in kaart te brengen; verzoekt de regering een plan van aanpak te maken met acties en maatregelen om deze financiers de pas af te snijden, en gaat over tot de orde van de dag. document.tekst_begin: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal 2 Vergaderjaar 2026–2027 37 020 XVII Vaststelling van de begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2027 Nr. 31 MOTIE VAN HET LID DOBBE Voorgesteld tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg van 5 november 2026 De Kamer, gehoord de beraadslaging, constaterende dat 40% van de vrouwenorganisaties wereldwijd hun werk geheel of gedeeltelijk moet stoppen in het komende jaar, als gevolg van bezuinigingen op vrouwenrechten; constaterende dat deze organisaties van levensbelang zijn voor vrouwen in conflictgebieden, die vaak slachtoffer van seksueel geweld zijn; verzoekt de regering extra inspanningen te leveren om te voorkomen dat deze organisaties hun werk moeten stoppen, en gaat over tot de orde van de dag. document.tekst_begin: 1 Stichting Urgente Noden (SUN) Nederland Seinstraat 22, 1223 DA Hilversum info@sunnederland.nl | www.sunnederland.nl Jongvolwassenen met jeugdhulp SUN-PROJECT JONGVOLWASSENEN Deel 3 en de inzet van proactieve noodhulp 2 Voorwoord De afgelopen jaren is veel aandacht ontstaan voor de positie van jongeren die opgroeien met jeugdhulp. De afbouw van gesloten jeugdhulp, de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd en de recente erkenning dat jongeren in gesloten instellingen niet altijd de bescherming kregen die zij nodig hadden, hebben het debat verscherpt. Tegelijkertijd blijft één ontwikkeling hardnekkig zichtbaar: voor veel jongvolwassenen is de stap naar zelfstandigheid ingewikkeld en soms ronduit kwetsbaar. Jongvolwassenen die opgroeiden met jeugdhulp dragen vaak een geschiedenis met zich mee van instabiliteit, wisselingen van woonplek en het ontbreken van een stevig netwerk. Wanneer zij 18 jaar worden, verandert hun wereld abrupt. De jeugdhulpondersteuning waar zij als minderjarige op konden rekenen valt weg, terwijl tegelijkertijd hun verantwoordelijkheden en financiële druk toenemen. document.tekst_begin: Ministerie van Financiën TER BESLISSING ABA de minist > ss - v|n [ ota Kamerbrief Europese jaarbegroting 2027, inzet Ecofin- begrotingsraad en de derde aanvullende Europese begroting 2026 Aanleiding Op 10 november a.s. vindt de Ecofin begrotingsraad en triloog-onderhandeling over de Europese jaarbegroting voor 2027 plaats. items.titel: Beslisnota bij het verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving in verband met de uitfasering van energielabel E, F, en G bij huurwoningen (Kamerstuk 28325-333)
items.samenvatting_bron: None. Zaak:

document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op 17 september 2026 hebben zeven fracties uit de Vaste Commissie voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening in totaal 60 vragen gesteld over het Ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving in verband met de uitfasering van energielabel E, F, en G bij huurwoningen (Kamerstuk 28325, nr. 333). Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd akkoord te gaan met de brief aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer, deze te ondertekenen en te laten verzenden. Kern • De energielabels E of slechter worden in het ontwerpbesluit uitgefaseerd door het stellen van een minimale energieprestatie-eis in het Bbl aan bestaande huurwoningen per 1 januari 2029. Deze energieprestatie-eis verplicht de verhuurder de huurwoning naar minimaal energielabel D te brengen. Er worden geen specifieke maatregelen voorgeschreven. Niet voldoen aan de eis resulteert in beginsel in handhaving door de gemeente, via een aanschrijving en het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom aan de verhuurder. Er komt géén verhuurverbod voor huurwoningen in de regelgeving. Verhuurders kunnen de woning blijven verhuren, maar er gaan wel eisen gelden waardoor zij de energievraag van de woning moeten verlagen

document.tekst_begin: Aan minister BZK staatssecretaris BZK Van dgDOO TER ONDERTEKENING Nota actief openbaar Ja Onze referentie 2026-0000508775 Datum Oktober 2026 Opgesteld door Samengewerkt met AIVD, DEF/MIVD, BZK/CZW, EZK Bijlage(n) 2 Pagina 1 van 2 Beslisnota bij TK brief derde voortgangsrapportage Veilig inkopen (voorheen ABRO) Aanleiding Bijgaand treft u de derde voortgangsrapportage van het programma Veilig inkopen (voorheen ABRO: Algemene Beveiligingseisen Rijksoverheidsopdrachten) aan de Tweede Kamer aan. De tweede voortgangsrapportage van 28 november 2026 ging vooral over het besluit dat de regering het ABRO-stelsel had aanvaard met als datum van inwerking 1 januari 2026. In deze derde rapportage meldt u de Tweede Kamer de voortgang n.a.v. de eerste ambitie in dit besluit. Dat gaat om de implementatie bij de departementen, hun diensten en agentschappen en de politie (tranche 1). Ook gaat dat om de stand van zaken van de voorbereidingen om de ABRO van toepassing te verklaren op andere overheden, vitale sectoren en enkele andere (overheids)organisaties. Dat gaat om de 2e ambitie van Regering en Tweede Kamer. Geadviseerd besluit Instemmen met en ondertekenen van de derde voortgangsrapportage ABRO

document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding In het Coalitieakkoord is afgesproken dat het parlementair stelsel wordt verbeterd met een aantal vernieuwingsvoorstellen uit de staatscommissie Remkes, waaronder de invoering van een terugzendrecht voor de Eerste Kamer. In uw Kamerbrief over de Grondwetsagenda 2026 hebt u aangekondigd om in het najaar de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag uit te brengen. Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd om: 1. in te stemmen met de bijgevoegde nota naar aanleiding van het verslag, waarin de vragen worden beantwoord in lijn met het wetsvoorstel en de toelichting; 2. de aanbiedingsbrief te ondertekenen; 3. de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag te ondertekenen. Kern Om de behandeling van de drie voorstellen over de Eerste Kamer te herstarten, hebt u aangekondigd eerst met het terugzendrecht aan de slag te gaan. Dit voorstel ligt nu bij de Tweede Kamer in de fase van de schriftelijke voorbereiding. U kunt de behandeling hervatten door de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag uit te brengen. fragmenten.fragment: …is ‘Perspectief Groningen & Noord-Drenthe’. 16 Water, bodem en klimaat als ordenende principes De uitvoering van de Economische Agenda Nij Begun vindt plaats binnen de fysieke en ecologische grenzen van Groningen en Noord- Drenthe. Water, bodem, klimaatadaptatie en waterveiligheid vormen daarom geen afzonderlijk thema, maar zijn randvoorwaarden en ordenende principes…

…vantie van de sector te versterken. De ambitie is een intensieve regionale samenwerking tussen bedrijven, kennisinstellingen en overheden gericht op een toekomstbestendig maritiem ecosysteem. Deze samenwerking stelt het regionaal verdienvermogen centraal en stelt de sector in staat te verduurzamen en te innoveren. Hierdoor ontstaat meer ruimte om talent aan te trekken…

…. Voor de markt zijn dit vaak risicovolle investeringen, waardoor plannen niet vanzelf van de grond komen. Daarom ontwikkelen we samen met organisaties als Roemte en Het Groninger Landschap een financieringsinstrument . Hiermee kunnen we een deel van de risico’s op- vangen en ruimte maken voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe locaties. Publiekstrekkers met bovenregionale u…

Dertig jaar lang wordt gewerkt aan herstel en perspectief. De gevolgen van de gaswinning laten diepe sporen na bij een groot deel van onze inwoners. Een noodzakelijke voorwaarde voor een betere toekomst is het herstel van woningen en mensen. Zolang als nodig. Koste wat kost. Het aanpakken van schade, versterking en herstel is daarom de belangrijkste prioriteit. Daarnaast is 200 miljoen euro per jaar beschikbaar voor sociaal en economisch perspectief. document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op vrijdag 16 oktober is het Meerjarig Uitvoeringsplan (MUP) 2026-2028 van de Economische Agenda voor Groningen en Noord-Drenthe vastgesteld in de ministerraad (MR). Het MUP is een strategische uitwerking van de Economische Agenda. Geadviseerd besluit • U kunt instemmen met het verzenden van de Kamerbrief, zoals ook besloten tijdens de MR. Kern • Het MUP heeft zowel aan regio- als aan Rijkszijde een besluitvormingstraject doorlopen. De regio heeft het MUP op 1 oktober in het AB van de GR Perspectief Groningen en Noord-Drenthe vastgesteld. • Aan Rijkszijde is het MUP op 10 september vastgesteld in de Hoog Ambtelijke Commissie Groningen met enkele kleine tekstuele wijzigingen. Vervolgens is het MUP besproken in de Commissie voor de Fysieke Leefomgeving op 29 september jl. • Er is ingestemd met het MUP en besloten tot rechtstreekse doorgeleiding naar de MR van 16 oktober. document.tekst_begin: Aanleiding Op 1 oktober jl. heeft de vaste commissie voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening het verslag uitgebracht bij het wetsvoorstel verzamelwijziging Kadasterwet. In de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag worden de in het verslag gestelde vragen beantwoord. Geadviseerd besluit U wordt geadviseerd de volgende stukken te ondertekenen. • De brief aan de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer; • De nota naar aanleiding van het verslag. Kern In het verslag van de Tweede Kamer zijn vragen gesteld door de leden van de D66-fractie, de VVD-fractie en de CDA-fractie. In de inleiding uiten zij zich positief over het wetsvoorstel, met name vanwege de verduidelijking en lastenverlichting die het wetsvoorstel teweegbrengt, maar hebben zij wel nog enkele vragen. Het betreft met name vragen om nadere informatie, die goed beantwoord konden worden. Tevens uit de BBB-fractie in de inleiding waardering voor het wetsvoorstel, zonder vragen te stellen. document.tekst_begin: Pagina 2 van 4 Datum 12 oktober 2026 Onze referentie 2026- Reactie op motie lid Ceulemans (JA21) • Er zijn drie moties aangenomen, waarvan één motie ook mogelijke gevolgen kan hebben voor het ontwerpbesluit. Het betreft de motie van het lid Ceulemans. In de motie wordt de regering verzocht per kwartaal vast te stellen welke nationaliteiten onder de grens van het gestelde inwilligingspercentage (20%) zitten en asielzoekers die daaronder vallen vanaf dat moment uit te sluiten van toegang tot de arbeidsmarkt. • Over dit onderwerp hebben lid Ceulemans (JA21) en lid Boomsma (PVV) eerder ook een amendement ingediend tijdens de behandeling van de wijziging van wetgeving betreffende het EU asiel- en migratiepact. In deze brief was opgenomen dat u de motie ontraadt. Vraag 2 Klopt het dat per 2027 structureel 10 procent van het jaarbudget, oftewel € 700.000, bezuinigd zal worden op de Luisterlijn? Zo nee, om welk bedrag gaat het dan? De Staat is tegen de uitspraak in beroep gegaan. • Ondertussen komt 2030 dichterbij, terwijl wij nog niet op koers liggen om de doelen te halen. Can the Spatial Planning of Livestock Production Tackle Future Nitrogen Pollution in China?
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract Nitrogen (N) pollution from livestock production significantly threatens China’s air and water quality, necessitating innovative solutions to balance food security and environmental sustainability. Studies have mostly overlooked the spatial heterogeneity of N-related environmental impacts and the trade-offs between reducing ammonia (NH3) emissions and N concentrations in water. This study develops a spatially explicit multiscale model system encompassing 13,000 polygons across China to assess soil N balance, NH3 emission intensity, and N concentrations in surface water, aiming to explore integrated spatial-planning (SP) strategies that maximize synergy and minimize trade-offs. Our findings reveal that single-purpose SP scenarios (e.g., reducing NH3 emissions or instream N concentrations) can effectively address one N-related issue but produce substantial trade-offs, leaving >50% of China’s population exposed to at least another N-related problem. However, an integrated SP approach could reduce harmful N exposures for 90% of China’s population while ensuring food security. This approach involves reallocating 14% of livestock production, reducing livestock numbers by one-third relative to the 2050 baseline, and implementing advanced technologies to mitigate N pollution hotspots. items.titel: Plant invasions in Natura 2000 habitats in Poland are driven primarily by macroclimatic factors
items.samenvatting_bron: Invasive plants pose an ecological threat around the world. Their influence can also be observed in protected areas such as the European Ecological Network Natura 2000. Although invasions can endanger protected habitats, the specific impact of invasive species in such areas and the factors that determine their spread remain understudied. This study aimed to analyse the factors influencing the probability of plant invasion in five groups of habitat types protected under the EU Habitats Directive, based on Polish State Monitoring of Natura 2000 data. A total of 2,096 monitoring sites, with a balanced distribution across the country, were analysed, belonging to broadleaf forests, riverine habitats, dry grasslands, mesic and wet grasslands, and mires. The study confirmed the presence of 45 invasive species and two potentially invasive species. The probability of invasion was much higher in regions with milder and wetter winters and, at the same time, in areas with a more continental climate. items.titel: Urgent call for a peat reduction strategy and against the expansion of peat extraction
items.samenvatting_bron: Peatlands are vital for climate regulation, water management and biodiversity conservation. Yet peat extraction for horticultural growing media continues, despite its substantial greenhouse gas emissions and the availability of alternatives. Recent industry calls to simplify the regulatory framework for peat extraction and use underscore the importance of a clear, long-term European policy.This position paper calls for a binding European strategy to progressively reduce peat use in horticulture and phase out peat extraction. Its recommendations include:- Immediately protecting natural and semi-natural peatlands from extraction and preventing illegal extraction.- Ending new extraction permits and permit extensions by 2030 at the latest, and phasing out peat extraction by 2050.- Introducing binding, sector-specific targets for reducing peat use, including a ban on peat in the hobby gardening market by 2030.- Supporting sustainable peat alternatives, supply chains, research and paludiculture, alongside a fair transition for affected growers and regions.- Improving transparency, consumer information and accountability for the environmental costs of peat use.The statement builds on the 2023 Power to the Peatlands declaration and is supported by an international coalition of scientific experts, environmental organisations and other stakeholders.The full document contains the collectively endorsed position, its scientific references and the list of signatories. items.titel: Under Liberalism
items.samenvatting_bron: In 1840, Lisbon became one of the first European capital to establish a municipal department exclusively dedicated to urban green infrastructure. Born from the Liberal reforms that enhanced the municipality of Lisbon, the Department of Gardens and Green Grounds played a decisive role in reshaping the city’s identity through public gardens, tree-lined boulevards, and afforestation programmes. Despite financial constraints, political instability, and Lisbon’s limited hydraulic infrastructure, the department oversaw the creation of iconic landmarks such as Estrela Garden and Avenida da Liberdade and advanced afforestation as a matter of political ideology, urban improvement, public hygiene, and civic education and moralization. Over five decades, the department designed the green infrastructure, professionalized its workforce, institutionalized ecological values, and integrated scientific expertise into urban planning. Its trajectory reflected broader struggles between centralization and municipal autonomy, with afforestation and green space management emerging as key arenas of Liberal modernization and ecopolitics. By the 1890s, however, financial crises, state centralization, and bureaucratic rivalries led to its dissolution on the turn of the twentieth century, leaving projects unfinished until its re-establishment under the Estado Novo in the twentieth century.

items.samenvatting_bron: ABSTRACT Chinese cities face the challenge of accelerating the low‐carbon transition while preserving cultural identity, spatial quality, and social sustainability in heritage‐sensitive areas. This study develops a decision‐support framework aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to prioritize strategies integrating cultural heritage preservation, renewable energy, and sustainable urban development under uncertainty. The Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) was applied to determine the relative importance of the criteria and sub‐criteria, while Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)‐Grey analysis was used to rank the proposed strategies based on expert judgments. The findings of Fuzzy AHP identified Urban Aesthetics as the most important main criterion, followed by Renewable Energy Integration and Preservation of Historic Sites. items.samenvatting_bron: Climate warming and demographic change pose interconnected challenges to urban sustainability, particularly for older adults and children who may face limited access to urban parks and elevated summer land surface temperatures. items.titel: How Firm Is a DNA Barcode Species Name? Reading the Pipeline at Several of Its Own Settings
items.samenvatting_bron: DNA barcoding names a species from a short stretch of its DNA. The sequencer gives the reads, a pipeline cleans and groups them, and a model compares them with a reference library to give a name. Each step has settings, and published studies show that the settings change the answer. Today a sample gets a name, and at best a probability from a model trained for that purpose. This concept note describes a different reading. The reads of the sample are kept exactly as they are. The settings of the pipeline (way one) and of the matching model (way two) are moved a little, and the same model names the species at each setting. If the names stay together, the name is firm. If they spread out, the name depends on a setting. A computer-decided shunting action then moves the doubtful sample aside to a safer track, without waiting for a person, while the other samples carry on. Three states are described: steady, watch and look closer. The note reviews the related work (PROTAX, bootstrap confidence in DADA2, studies of clustering thresholds and denoising tools, ensembles of neural networks, Bayesian methods and Monte Carlo dropout) and explains in simple language how this method differs from each. It is relevant to barcode databases, sequencer software, environmental DNA surveys, food authenticity testing and wildlife forensics. Patent pending. Keywords: DNA barcoding, metabarcoding, species identification, firmness of AI verdict, pipeline settings, shunting action, environmental DNA

items.titel: Radiographically Confirmed Vertebral Deformities in a Wild Schizothorax plagiostomus from the Lidder River, Kashmir Himalaya, India
items.samenvatting_bron: Vertebral deformities are well documented in cultured fishes but remain poorly reported in wild populations, particularly in cold-water Himalayan taxa. Here, we report the first radiographically confirmed case of vertebral deformity in a wild Schizothorax plagiostomus (n = 1) collected from the Lidder River, a major tributary of the Jhelum River system, India. Digital radiography revealed multiple axial skeletal anomalies affecting distinct vertebral regions. Lordosis was observed in vertebrae V16–V26 within the precaudal (medial) region, while scoliosis extended from vertebrae V27–V33 across the precaudal and caudal regions. Ankylosis involving vertebrae V30–V33 resulted in partial fusion of caudal elements and an estimated 17% reduction in caudal peduncle length relative to morphologically normal conspecifics. To contextualize the deformity, morphometric comparisons were made with ten apparently normal individuals from the same population. Mean (± SD) values for standard length (235 ± 8 mm vs. 239 ± 6 mm), body depth (48 ± 3 mm vs. 52 ± 4 mm), and head length (62 ± 2 mm vs. 65 ± 3 mm) indicated measurable deviations in body proportions associated with the deformity. Twenty-one morphometric and five meristic characters were recorded following standard ichthyological protocols. Given the single-case design, no inferential statistics were applied. items.titel: Ancient environmental DNA reveals the distinct fingerprints of whaling and climate change on Antarctic marine biodiversity
items.samenvatting_bron: Abstract The Southern Ocean is a disproportionately large contributor to Earth system processes, playing a crucial role in the global transport of carbon, oxygen and heat. It also hosts enormous seasonal biological productivity that supports diverse endemic marine biodiversity. Industrial whaling in the first half of the 20th century and recent human-driven climate change have both profoundly altered Antarctic ecosystems, but ecological surveys of these impacts are limited to well-known taxa in the short period since monitoring began. Here, we analysed five sediment records to reconstruct more than two centuries of ecosystem change across the Western Antarctic Peninsula, spanning periods before and during major human impacts. Environmental DNA metabarcoding of these records revealed substantial biodiversity shifts, with change accelerating in recent decades. We find a significant role for both climate change and whaling in restructuring communities, identifying unique variance in whole-community change explained by each driver. Moreover, we find a negative association between whaling and metazoan families which feed from the water column, suggesting that pre-whaling ecosystems had greater pelagic productivity. Overall, our results reveal baseline Antarctic biodiversity from long before observational records and identify a distinct fingerprint of human drivers in this fragile, rapidly changing ecosystem.

items.samenvatting_bron: Climate change and anthropogenic pressures are increasing risks to coastal systems, feeding the need for adaptation strategies that are both effective and socially accepted. Nature-based solutions (NBS) are gaining prominence for reducing risks while strengthening ecosystem resilience, but their implementation depends heavily on stakeholder acceptance. This study assesses local perspectives on coastal protection in Costa da Caparica, Portugal, a low-lying, densely occupied area exposed to erosion and flooding. Using a participatory framework, combining the Analytic Hierarchy Process with participatory mapping, five stakeholder groups, comprising residents, technical experts, and public authorities, evaluated decision criteria, preferred adaptation strategies, and gaps in current coastal protection. Results show that protection efficacy and maintenance costs were the most influential decision factors, while environmental co-benefits were less valued, particularly by residents. Although most groups favored NBS, the residents/businesses group preferred hard defenses, associating them with greater safety. items.titel: Ecohydrology‐Informed Machine Learning for Floodplain Vegetation Classification to Support Riverine Nature‐Based Solutions
items.samenvatting_bron: ABSTRACT Floodplain restorations are an increasingly common nature‐based solution (NbS) to support flood risk reduction and enhance ecosystem services while protecting biodiversity. Monitoring vegetation structure and habitats in restored floodplains is critically important to support evidence‐based NbS implementation and biodiversity conservation interventions. Remote sensing (RS)‐based machine learning (ML) methods for floodplain vegetation mapping are complicated by hydrology driven, spatiotemporally dynamic habitat mosaics, high heterogeneity, spatial interspersion, and spectral mixing. Leveraging prevailing theory of floodplain ecology, ecohydrology‐informed ML modeling could improve habitat classifications. We tested the effectiveness of a novel RS and hydrological data fusion to classify vegetation and land cover types in floodplains along the lower Missouri River using supervised ML algorithms. Extreme Gradient Boosting model results showed higher classification accuracy from RS hydrological data fusion (overall accuracy, OA = 85.8%, kappa = 0.84) over multisensor (optical radar) RS data fusion (OA = 80%, Kappa = 0.77). Certain land cover classes, particularly those with structurally similar vegetative communities but ecologically important differences in hydrology (e.g., soil moisture, subcanopy inundation), showed greater classification uncertainty. items.titel: Centralized Infrastructure
items.samenvatting_bron: Focusing on the long and fragmented history of Lisbon’s Parque Eduardo VII, from the international competition for the unrealized Parque da Liberdade in 1887 to the consolidation of the park and the Estufa Fria under the Estado Novo dictatorship in the mid-twentieth century, this chapter argues that Lisbon’s imperial ambitions and engagement with international models of urban modernity were persistently constrained by the financial, and administrative, limitations of a peripheral capital. Designed by the French landscape architect Henri Lusseau for a site with a natural amphitheatre-like topography, the nineteenth-century project combined expansive lawns, curvilinear paths, and dense tree and shrub plantings with an elaborate technological infrastructure. Ultimately unrealized, the Parque da Liberdade illuminates the circulation of French picturesque models, the professionalization, and marginalization of gardeners and landscape architects in Portugal, and the growing dominance of engineers in shaping urban nature. Under the Estado Novo, the park was reformulated through technocratic planning, scientific arborization, and monumental urban design, becoming an instrument of authoritarian modernization and civic order. A32 weer open na afsluiting vanwege risico vallende glasplaten
items.samenvatting_bron: De A32 ter hoogte van Grou in Friesland is in beide richtingen weer open. De weg werd donderdagavond afgesloten vanwege een gevaarlijke situatie bij het Aquaduct Mid-Fryslân. Boosdoeners waren de glasplaten van de lampen boven het wegdek, die naar beneden konden vallen. Alle lichtbakken in het aquaduct zijn volgens Omrop Fryslân inmiddels weggehaald en het wegdek is gereinigd. Dat betekent dat er tijdelijk geen licht is in de tunnelbak. De werkzaamheden gingen voorspoediger dan verwacht. Vrijdagavond rond 20.00 uur ging de weg richting Leeuwarden vanuit Heerenveen alweer open, later ook de andere kant. Slijtage De in totaal 84 lichtbakken in het aquaduct, 42 per rijrichting, hadden volgens Rijkswaterstaat door het intensieve verkeer, de zuigende werking van vrachtwagens en opspattend zout water te maken met slijtage. "We kunnen stellen dat er sprake is van materiaalmoeheid bij de lichtarmaturen. Deze hebben versneld het einde van hun technische levensduur bereikt." De wegbeheerder gaat de komende tijd ook andere aquaducten in Noord-Nederland onderzoeken op slijtage en schade aan de lichtbakken. De A32 loopt onder het Prinses Margrietkanaal door. De 66 kilometer lange snelweg is een belangrijke verkeersader in Noord-Nederland en verbindt Leeuwarden, Heerenveen en Meppel. Verkeer tussen Heerenveen en Leeuwarden werd tijdens de afsluiting omgeleid via Drachten, over de A7 en de N31.
